options.name: archival_copy
options.description: Specifies the list of external targets to be added while creating policy.

options.name: blackout_window
options.description: Specifies the list of blackout windows.

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: days_to_retain
options.description: Specifies the number of retention days.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the description for the policy created

options.name: full_backup_schedule
options.description: Specifies the full backup schedule for policy creation

options.name: incremental_backup_schedule
options.description: Specifies the incremental backup schedule for policy creation

options.name: log_backup_schedule
options.description: Specifies the log backup schedule for policy creation

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the protection policy.

options.name: replication_copy
options.description: Specifies the list of replication cluster to be added while creating policy.

options.name: retries
options.description: Specifies the retry count while policy creation.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Policy. (C)present a policy will be created. (C)absent will remove the policy.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
